Mihono Bourbon saw the Japanese Derby 
through to the end, living up to her fans' 
expectations.

Though she crossed the finish line in a 
brilliant 1st place, the dream of the 
Triple Crown was already lost. Yet, a 
mysterious desire welled up within her—she 
wanted to run in the Kikuka Sho as well—

Similarly, Rice Shower appeals with a 
desire to "catch up" that has nothing to 
do with winning or losing. Her heart is 
filled with things that simply cannot be 
resolved easily...

The Trainer consoled Mihono Bourbon, 
saying, "A day will come when you'll 
understand." Next up was the final leg of 
the Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho.
